description: WRITE tool — stop tracking one keyword/app pair in the caller's Sonar workspace. Identify the pair by its tracked-keyword id (from sonar_app_keywords). Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

tracked_keyword_id.description: The tracked-keyword UUID — the `id` returned by sonar_app_keywords. NOT the keyword_id.

name: sonar_delete_tracked_keyword
title: Delete Tracked Keyword
